_comment: The software this branch needs on the Noticeboard server Pi, besides the packages npm installs. Keep it up to date on every branch: when a change needs new software, or a newer version of something listed, update this file in the same commit. Before switching branch, the admin panel checks the Pi against the target branch's list (Settings → Software updates). versions: space-separated conditions must all hold; || separates alternatives; * means any version.

software.name: Node.js
software.neededFor: Running the Noticeboard server. Some of its modules only load on Node.js 20.19 or newer (or 22.12 or newer).
software.install: Run the Noticeboard installer again: it installs Node.js 20 when the Pi's version is too old.

software.name: npm
software.neededFor: Installing the Noticeboard's packages when it updates.
software.install: It comes with Node.js: run the Noticeboard installer again.

software.name: FFprobe
software.neededFor: Reading the length of uploaded videos.
software.install: sudo apt install ffmpeg (FFprobe comes with it)

software.name: Chromium
software.neededFor: Showing the slideshow full screen on this Pi's own screen.
software.install: sudo apt install chromium (on older Raspberry Pi OS: chromium-browser)
